UX surface The repo verbs — build, verify, test, docs, i18n, media, setup, scaffold.

Members

REPO_ROOT

Absolute repository root (shared/scripts/../..).

PLATFORM_MODULES

Fixed platform modules — ordered so cheap shared suites run first. root is where reports/coverage lands; src lists the authored-source roots (repo-relative) that enter that module's filtered coverage map.

discoverModules

Discovers every workspace module: the fixed platform modules plus each experiments// dir that ships a jest.config.mjs (sorted for deterministic run order).

  • @returns {Array<{name:string, root:string, src:string[]}>} module records.
